sections.title: Evolution's Laboratory
sections.description: This Global Seminar is a version of PHIL 1830 and will conclude with field work in the Galapagos Islands. This course is a Penn Global Seminar, which includes a travel component. An application is required. For more information and to apply, visit: https://global.upenn.edu/pennabroad/pgs
